settings.label: Logo
settings.info: Used by the header and footer when those sections have no logo of their own. Leave empty to use the packaged brand logo assets.

settings.label: Accent colour
settings.info: Drives --accent: filled buttons, active nav, icons, headline accent.

settings.label: Bright accent colour
settings.info: Drives --accent-bright: focus rings, small stat numbers, promo links.

settings.label: Free download URL
settings.info: Every Download for Free button on the storefront points here.

settings.label: Before and after video
settings.info: Upload the MP4 under Settings then Files in Shopify, copy its URL and paste it here. Shopify does not allow video files inside a theme, so this cannot be bundled. Leave empty to show the still image instead.
